title: Chapter 70 Xie Fan In Sunset City
content:
Chapter 70 Xie Fan In Sunset City

Xie Fan is a talent cultivated by Lord Sunset since childhood. He ranks among the top ten young talents in Sunset City.

He is a pillar of talent that Lord Sunset City values very much.

And he has been adopted by Lord Sunset as his adopted son!

After layers of selection, he finally got this opportunity to participate in the battle for the village building order in Dahuai Domain.

The main task of these people selected by lords from outside the domain is to develop their own power in this area, which is equivalent to planting a nail to facilitate future intervention in local affairs.

If they can unify Dahuai Domain, it is equivalent to adding a large territory to their own territory, which can be said to have made great contributions.

Therefore, countless people, fighting hard, also want to enter this new area.

They have been influenced by the outside world and have undergone special training. Compared with these novice players, they have incomparable advantages.

Apart from anything else, Xie Fan's level advantage is absolutely obvious.

"Ling'er, do you know how worried Lord Qingyang is about you when you sneaked in?"

"It's none of your business. Also, don't call me Ling'er. We're not that close."

Wang Shuo watched the two of them silently from the side. It seemed that Dongfang Ling and this guy named Xie Fan were friends rather than enemies.

Seeing that Dongfang Ling was a little bit angry, Xie Fan was not angry.

Lord Qingyang Dongfang Ke and Lord Sunset Wang Zhu had a close relationship and had formed an alliance long ago.

Therefore, the people of the two territories moved around quite frequently.

Xie Fan naturally knew the temper of this young lady, so he patiently said: "Ling'er, you don't know yet that Lord Tiexue has sent Ni Wu into the Dahuai Territory. One of his goals is to capture you and use this to threaten Lord Qingyang."

When Dongfang Ling heard this, his face twitched unnaturally and he was a little panicked.

This Ni Wu is the first person of the younger generation of Tiexue Ridge, and he is very famous.

And Tiexue Ridge is their mortal enemy of Qingyang City, always thinking about annexing them.

"Young Master, Young Master, come here and scare me. I'm not afraid!" Dongfang Ling said bravely, but it was obvious that he was a little timid.

Wang Shuo was shocked when he saw Dongfang Ling's performance. Is this world so dangerous?

After hesitating for a while, he couldn't help asking: "How powerful is this Ni Wu?"

Xie Fan turned around and glanced at Wang Shuo, and then showed a look of contempt.

Seeing that the other party ignored him, Wang Shuo's old face turned red and he was a little embarrassed.

Dongfang Ling saw this and explained: "It is said that Ni Wu has S-level qualifications. When he was at level 10, he killed a silver boss."

Wang Shuo swallowed a mouthful of saliva and couldn't speak for a long time.

This is a pervert.

At this time, Wang Shuo couldn't even fight a bronze boss alone!

"I guess the equipment on him must be very powerful?" Wang Shuo was a little unwilling to give up and wanted to find a way out for himself.

"Legend has it that he used a blank suit at that time, and he defeated the boss with his own fighting skills and powerful basic attributes." Dongfang Ling also looked envious and said somewhat unconfidently.

After hearing this, Wang Shuo stopped talking, and a storm was set off in his heart.

It is true that people are angry when they compare themselves to others!

"Ling'er, now you know how dangerous your situation is! Now follow me, I will protect you!" Xie Fan looked proud, and finally had the opportunity to be alone with Dongfang Ling.

"Just you? Can you beat Ni Wu?" Dongfang Ling looked at Xie Fan with disdain and sarcastically said unceremoniously.

"Don't worry, even if I lose my life, I will protect you." He immediately said loudly, with a righteous look.

"Whether you lose your life or not is none of my business. I can protect myself, and he will protect me too." Dongfang Ling pointed at Wang Shuo, and her face was slightly flushed.

Wang Shuo was somewhat innocently caught in the crossfire. He wanted to explain, when did I promise to protect you!

I just agreed to let you follow me.

Suddenly, Xie Fan glanced at Wang Shuo and laughed, "Just him? He can't even take one of my moves, how can he protect you."

Wang Shuo had to admit that the opponent's level was more than twice his own, and his attributes were likely several times his own. It was really possible that he couldn't take a single move.

I don't know who gave Wang Shuo the courage, he said to Xie Fan: "Don't bully the poor young man!"

"Haha..."

Xie Fan was amused by Wang Shuo: "I'm standing still, and I'm still using my hands and feet, let's fight?"

At this time, Ayub took a step forward and burst out with a strong desire to fight: "I'll fight you on behalf of the lord."

Xie Fan stretched out his finger and shook it in front of Ayub, sneering: "You are not my opponent either."

Just when the two sides were on the verge of a fight, Dongfang Ling said angrily: "Enough, aren't you bullying people? They are still newcomers, how can they beat you, I'll go with you."

I don't know for what purpose Dongfang Ling was willing to leave.

Xie Fan's attitude changed, and he smiled: "Ling'er, I'm doing this for your own good."

Dongfang Ling looked at Wang Shuo, forced a smile, and said casually: "Wang Shuo, thank you for saving me, we'll meet again if we're lucky!"

After that, he summoned a wind-chasing leopard, rode on it, and disappeared into the night in a flash.

"Ling'er, wait for me!" Xie Fan also quickly chased after him.

Fan Chengyang also breathed a sigh of relief, and then he also said goodbye!

The night was as cold as water, and Wang Shuo sat silently by the fire, looking like he was worried!

After learning about the situation of the players outside the domain, Wang Shuo frowned.

"Agui, how much do you know about the players outside the domain?"

"My Lord, the players outside the domain are just players who entered this world earlier than us. Some of them are natives who were born directly in this world."

"After a few years, we will become the same as them. My Lord, don't worry."

"Our current area has a protection mechanism. They have no way to invade on a large scale for the time being."

"Within the rules, we can send a few people in. As long as we develop fast enough, we will have the ability to compete with them."

Wang Shuo thought about it. He had only entered for 22 days. If he could beat these people who had entered for several years, it would be strange!

Take your time!

...

In the early morning, Wang Shuo breathed in the moist air and felt refreshed!

After breakfast, Gong Zheng and others had already packed up their tents.

Wang Shuo was very satisfied. It was different to have subordinates. He didn't have to do anything himself.

After walking for a while, we came to a small hill, where we could already see Nanshan Market.

Wang Shuo was in a good mood. Just now, he picked up another bronze treasure chest.

During this period, he had collected more than 20 bronze treasure chests and 1 silver treasure chest.

Suddenly, three girls rushed straight towards Wang Shuo and others.

Wang Shuo saw that these three people were only at level 8 or 9, and they were in a very bad state at the moment.

"Friends in front, help!" The leading woman shouted loudly.

Wang Shuo didn't want to meddle in other people's business, but these women kept getting closer and closer.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to see what the other party wanted.

After a few breaths, Wang Shuo suddenly wanted to curse.
